title: Beyond Scalar Leaderboards: Adaptive Sampling for Pareto Frontier Identification in Multi-Objective LLM Arenas
abstract: arXiv:2610.27447v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The evaluation of large language models (LLMs) is inherently multi-objective, as different models may offer different tradeoffs across performance dimensions such as math, code, and writing. Because such evaluations are often based on costly and time-consuming human feedback, it is important to draw reliable conclusions using as few comparisons as possible. In this paper, we present Vector-Borda Empirical-Gap Elimination (VB-EGE), a fixed-confidence adaptive sampling algorithm for efficiently identifying models on the Pareto frontier in arena-style evaluation, where each comparison evaluates a pair of models on a prompt with respect to a selected performance dimension. VB-EGE progressively eliminates models from an active set once sufficient statistical evidence has been accumulated to certify their Pareto status. Under a multi-objective Bradley-Terry model, we show that VB-EGE returns the correct Pareto frontier with high probability

translated_title: 超越标量排行榜：多目标LLM竞技场中帕累托前沿识别的自适应采样算法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.27447v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：大语言模型（LLM）的评估本质上是多目标的，因为不同模型可能在数学、代码、写作等性能维度上呈现不同的权衡关系。由于此类评估通常依赖成本高昂且耗时的人工反馈，因此如何用尽可能少的比较得出可靠结论至关重要。本文提出了向量-Borda经验差距消除算法（VB-EGE），这是一种固定置信度的自适应采样算法，用于在竞技场式评估中高效识别帕累托前沿上的模型，其中每次比较会针对选定的性能维度在某个提示上对一对模型进行评估。一旦积累了足够的统计证据以证实某模型的帕累托状态，VB-EGE就会将其从活跃集合中逐步消除。在多目标Bradley-Terry模型下，我们证明了VB-EGE能够以高概率返回正确的帕累托前沿
tldr: 本文提出了固定置信度的自适应采样算法VB-EGE，能在多目标LLM竞技场评估中以尽可能少的比较高效识别帕累托前沿上的模型，突破了单一标量排行榜的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes VB-EGE, a fixed-confidence adaptive sampling algorithm that efficiently identifies Pareto-optimal LLMs in multi-objective arena evaluations with as few pairwise comparisons as possible, moving beyond single scalar leaderboards.
